title: Asset Sovereignty: Decoupling Energy from Survival
hook: If your primary income requires real-time presence, your focus is owned by external variance.
core_insight: In 'Rich Dad Poor Dad', Kiyosaki defines an asset strictly as what puts money into your pocket, and a liability as what takes money out. Financial anxiety spikes when all capital inflows depend on immediate high-stress consulting hours. Channel surplus technical leverage into intellectual property, automated platforms, and cash-flowing reserves to construct an unshakeable operational buffer.
takeaways: Triage daily effort: dedicate fixed blocks to building assets that compound without live attendance.
Financial sovereignty reduces baseline anxiety, making you immune to client pressure.
external_reference: Robert Kiyosaki, Rich Dad Poor Dad
